items.title: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
items.summary: Google introduces Gemini 4 Argon, a new AI model designed to tackle complex challenges, signaling advancements in AI capabilities.

items.title: Anthropic reportedly plans to move forward with IPO plans
items.summary: Anthropic, a leading AI research company, is reportedly moving ahead with its initial public offering plans, indicating significant growth and market confidence in the AI sector.

items.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
items.summary: OpenAI announces the availability of ChatGPT Enterprise in the AWS Marketplace, making its advanced AI capabilities more accessible to businesses leveraging AWS infrastructure.

items.title: Qwenputer: a fully functioning, deterministic RISC-V CPU inside Qwen3.5
items.summary: Researchers have successfully embedded a fully functional, deterministic RISC-V CPU within the Qwen3.5 AI model, showcasing a novel integration of hardware architecture within a language model.

items.title: Jensen Huang reportedly engaged a PR firm with a history of handling high-profile sex scandals a year ago
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang reportedly hired a PR firm known for managing high-profile sex scandals a year prior, raising questions amid recent controversies.

items.title: A short seller flagged Nvidia CEO’s ties to a suspected Chinese spy six months before the scandal
items.summary: A short seller had reportedly alerted authorities to Nvidia CEO's alleged connections with a suspected Chinese spy half a year before the current scandal erupted.

items.title: Control Room: A central system to track and stop model workloads across our research infrastructure
items.summary: OpenAI introduces 'Control Room,' a centralized system designed to monitor and halt model workloads across its research infrastructure, enhancing safety and operational control.

items.title: Everyone Is Building AI to Replace Developers. Nobody Is Building the Plan for What Comes After.
items.summary: This article discusses the prevalent focus on AI replacing developers, highlighting a critical gap in planning for the future roles and societal implications post-automation.

items.title: Confucius4-R2T2: A Stable-Prefix Streaming ASR Model for Real Real-Time Transcription
items.summary: Confucius4-R2T2 is introduced as a new streaming Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) model that achieves real real-time transcription with stable prefixes, improving latency and accuracy for live applications.

items.title: SplatAnything: Gaussian Spacing Normalization for Feed-forward 3DGS across Arbitrary Scenes
items.summary: SplatAnything proposes a novel Gaussian Spacing Normalization technique to enable efficient feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting across diverse scenes, enhancing 3D reconstruction and rendering.

items.title: Toward the Era of Agentic Embodied Intelligence
items.summary: This paper explores the emerging field of agentic embodied intelligence, discussing the challenges and opportunities in developing AI agents that can interact with and learn from the physical world.

items.title: WorldFoundry: Towards Unified Infrastructure for World Intelligence
items.summary: WorldFoundry proposes a unified infrastructure aimed at fostering 'world intelligence' by integrating diverse AI capabilities to build more comprehensive and interactive simulated environments.

items.title: PCBRouteAgent: How Close Are LLM Agents to Becoming PCB Routing Engineers?
items.summary: This research investigates the current capabilities of Large Language Model (LLM) agents in performing complex PCB routing tasks, assessing their potential to automate electronic design.

items.title: LowRAM: Low-Rank Keys and Amortised Values for Composable KV Cache Compression at Test-Time
items.summary: LowRAM introduces a method for compressing KV caches at test-time using low-rank keys and amortized values, significantly reducing memory footprint for large language models.

items.title: LLMs Don't Know What They Know: Benchmarking Temporal Self-Knowledge for Financial Backtesting
items.summary: This study benchmarks the temporal self-knowledge of LLMs in financial backtesting, revealing limitations in their understanding of information timeliness and its impact on decision-making.
